content.title: RH, Other Furniture Stocks Finish Mixed Friday After Trump’s New Tariffs
content.summary: Home goods retailers pared early losses Friday after President Trump unveiled new tariffs on kitchen cabinets, upholstered furniture and bathroom vanities.  The levies include 50% duties on kitchen cabinets and 30% on upholstered furniture.  "The reason for this is the large-scale 'FLOODING' of these products into the United States," Trump said on Truth Social, adding that U.S. manufacturing needed to be protected on national-security grounds.
